gaps.sentence: The song reminds me ___ my first holiday abroad.
gaps.explanation: remind somebody OF something = make them remember; remind somebody ABOUT = tell them not to forget.

gaps.sentence: Residents complained ___ the noise every night.
gaps.explanation: complain ABOUT something (or complain TO somebody ABOUT it).

gaps.sentence: The manager was pleased ___ our progress.
I'm fed up ___ listening to excuses.

gaps.explanation: difference BETWEEN two things (difference IN price/size for the respect in which).
